s.area.w.s: For the association and every ownership share.
s.diag.h: From bank statement to rent account
s.diag.p: One line of the CAMT.053 file is checked, matched to a tenancy and booked to the rent account (Mietkonto). Split bookings and reversals are possible.
s.g1.p: Finalised statements and receipts can no longer be edited.
s.g2.p: You fix mistakes with a reversal and a correction, without deleting receipts.
s.g4.p: Access and erasure per person under the GDPR.
s.g5.p: Each organisation's data is separated from other organisations at row level.
s.m1: Properties and units with year built, areas, meters and meter readings
s.m2: Tenancy agreements with base rent, operating-cost advance payments and deposit
s.m3: Graduated rent, index-linked rent and rent changes from a set date
s.m4: Rent charges to the day, a rent account per tenancy, open items
s.m5: Tenant changes and deposits: due, paid, repaid
s.m6: Betriebskostenabrechnung (operating-cost statement) per tenancy, as a PDF
s.q1.a: Verwalino is free, both for the planned hosted service and for self-hosting. The software is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Source code: publication planned.
s.q2.a: Yes. You can export CSV files and DATEV files (SKR03/SKR04) and download every document as PDF. A full export of a whole organisation is planned.
s.q3.a: There is no technical limit. Quotas are planned for the hosted service. When you self-host, your own server sets the limit.
s.q3.q: How many units can Verwalino handle?
s.q4.a: Yes. Docker Compose starts Verwalino and PostgreSQL on a laptop or a server.
s.q4.q: Does it run on my laptop?
s.q5.a: No. AI suggestions when importing a Teilungserklärung (declaration of division) are optional and require your own OpenAI key. You review the suggestions.
s.q6.a: Hosted: on servers in Germany (planned). Self-hosted: with you, on your own server.
s.r1.p: Betriebskostenabrechnung (operating-cost statement) per tenancy, pro rata by time and accounting for vacancy. Allocate by floor area, MEA (ownership shares), units, people, consumption or manually. Advance payments come from recorded payments. Batch runs per property, suggested new advance payments and PDF output.
s.r2.p: Heating costs follow HeizkostenV (German Heating Costs Ordinance): split into base and consumption shares, or use an external statement.
s.r3.p: Carry paid Hausgeld (owners’ contributions) into the annual statement. The asset report follows § 28(4) WEG (German Condominium Act). Annual budgets and statements are available as PDFs.
s.r4.p: Bank statements as CSV or CAMT.053 (XML/ZIP) with preview and duplicate check. Matching suggestions, split bookings, reversal.
s.r5.p: Monthly rent by direct debit (pain.008) with creditor ID and mandates.
s.r6.p: Three reminder levels, a fee and late-payment interest: the base rate plus 5 percentage points under § 288 BGB (German Civil Code). Preview reminder runs and generate PDFs.
s.r7.p: Export for DATEV with chart of accounts SKR03 or SKR04. Plus CSV export and an annual overview per property.
s.r8.p: Upload supporting documents and create cost entries from them. OCR and electronic invoices (XML) run through a worker service. Cost items follow BetrKV (German Operating Costs Ordinance) categories.
